Customer is without heat. Same-day visit required in winter months.

## HP-VIESSMANN-A9 — Viessmann Vitocal — A9 (Compressor Overload) **Symptom.** Heat pump cycles into fault state on cold mornings, recovers mid-day. **Root cause.** Compressor start capacitor weakening; struggles under cold-start load. **Field fix.** Replace start capacitor on compressor board. **Required part.** `VIE-COMP-CAP-45UF`. **Severity.** Medium. Schedule within 5 days.

## GOO-115 — Goodwe GW-ET — Error 115 (Battery Communication Lost) **Symptom.** Hybrid system shows battery offline; PV still feeds grid normally. **Root cause.** CAN-bus cable between inverter and battery degraded or unseated. **Field fix.** Replace CAN cable; verify termination resistor on battery end. **Required part.** `GOO-CAN-CABLE-2M`. **Severity.** Medium.
